senses.gloss: ललज्जिह्व lalaj-jihva, a. having a lolling 🞄tongue.
ललल्ल la-lal-la, onom. of the sound of lisping.

लालाट lālāṭa, a. being on the forehead 🞄(lalāṭa): i-ka, a. id.;
 ī, f. forehead.
ललाटिका lalāṭ-ikā, f. forehead mark made 🞄with sandal or other powder.

ललाम lalā́ma, a. (ī́) having a forehead 🞄mark;
 m. n. ornament, decoration: -n, n. id. 🞄(C.).
लालित lāl-ita, cs. pp. √ lal: -ka, m. favourite, 🞄darling, pet.
लल्यान lalyāna, N. of a locality.

लल्ल lalla, m. N. of an astronomer and a minister: 🞄ā, f. N. of a courtesan;
 i-ya, m. N..
लाला lāl-ā, f. saliva, spittle: -pāna, n. sucking 🞄of saliva.

लालक lāla-ka, a. (ikā) caressing;
 m. court 🞄fool.

लालस lā-las-a, intv. a. ardently desiring, 🞄eager for, delighting or absorbed in, devoted 🞄to (lc., —˚);
 m., ā, f. ardent longing, devotion 🞄to (lc.).
लालाय lālā-ya, den. Ā. secrete saliva: 🞄pp. i-ta, foaming at the mouth.
लालित्य lālit-ya, n. [fr. lalita] loveliness, 🞄grace, charm.

लालिन् lāl-in, a. fondling, coaxing;
 -ya, 🞄fp. to be fonded or coaxed.
